Title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
Company: Orion Cloud Systems
Location: Remote - United States
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: $88,000 per year

We are seeking a senior technical support engineer with 5+ years of enterprise SaaS support experience, escalation ownership, ServiceNow administration, customer communication, and team leadership.
Responsibilities include mentoring junior staff, handling complex escalations, and coordinating with engineering and account teams.
